title: Enhancing LLM-based building data query with chain-of-thought, retrieval-augmented generation, and fine-tuning
task: Brick建筑语义数据自然语言查询与SPARQL生成执行
inputData: Brick Schema RDF/OWL语义模型 + 自然语言查询；训练集来自40栋真实建筑，零样本测试来自5栋留出建筑
contribution: 提出BuildingGPT2，将LLaMA 3.1-70B的LoRA领域微调、Vector-Graph RAG和Chain-of-Thought结合，在Brick语义模型上提升自然语言到SPARQL查询能力，并以跨建筑零样本测试验证实体消歧和多跳推理。
abstract: BuildingGPT2 extends natural-language access to Brick semantic building models by combining LLM fine-tuning, vector-graph retrieval-augmented generation and chain-of-thought prompting. It is trained on semantic models from 40 real buildings and evaluated zero-shot on five held-out buildings, improving SPARQL query-generation accuracy from 49.25% to 97.11% with LLaMA 3.1-70B.
methodology: BuildingGPT2 uses the Brick RDF/OWL representation and an end-to-end natural-language-to-SPARQL pipeline. VG-RAG retrieves relevant entities, classes and graph relations to resolve building-specific identifiers and schema context; chain-of-thought prompting structures reasoning; and LLaMA 3.1-70B is domain-adapted with LoRA. Semantic models from 40 real buildings provide training data, while five entirely held-out buildings are used for zero-shot evaluation, separating domain adaptation from test-building memorization.
results: The integrated BuildingGPT2 framework raises SPARQL query-generation accuracy from 49.25% for the base setting to 97.11% on zero-shot building tests. The paper's ablation/comparative analysis attributes gains to complementary effects of domain fine-tuning, VG-RAG grounding and structured reasoning, with the strongest improvements on complex entity-disambiguation and multi-hop queries.
taskEn: Natural-language querying of Brick building semantic data with SPARQL generation and execution
inputDataEn: Brick Schema RDF/OWL semantic models and natural-language queries; 40 real-building models for training and five held-out buildings for zero-shot testing
operationEvidence: BuildingGPT2 retrieves graph/entity context, generates SPARQL aligned to Brick semantics, and executes those queries against the semantic building models.
relationshipNote: Distinct peer-reviewed extension of BuildingGPT: the earlier paper evaluates training-free VG-RAG on 45 buildings, whereas BuildingGPT2 adds LoRA fine-tuning and CoT, trains on 40 buildings, and tests zero-shot on five held-out buildings.
